programme.desc: Visitámos o Eric Torres em Mequinenza, para viver uma jornada de inverno de carp fishing a partir de embarcação, Possivelmente uma das modalidades mais desconhecidas e pouco praticadas do carp fishing. Neste reportagem descobriremos todos os truques para ter sucesso.

programme.title: Conejos Con Podenco Chico
programme.desc: Despues de recorrer mas de 1500 km desde Islandia y Groenlandia, miles de gansos llegan a las tierras altas de Escocia en busca de alimento y tranquilidad. Su caza se ha especializado de manera espectacular ofreciendo increibles tiradas.

programme.title: Carpas Desde Embarcação
programme.desc: Ubicado en la comarca de Sobrarbe en pleno Pirineo Aragonés el término de Plan alberga una buena población de Sarrios, especie que intentará cazar un grupo de jovenes recechistas.

programme.title: Gansos En Las Tierras Altas
programme.desc: A 'Barbearia Ibérica' desloca-se nesta ocasião para a zona alta do rio Guadalquivir. O objetivo, para aprender em primeira mão sobre a situação atual do barbo cigano em um enclave tão majestoso como a Sierra de Cazorla, Segura e Las Villas. Um passeio por um dos mais belos territórios de Espanha, em que depois de muita pesquisa, acabamos por saborear a pesca destes peixes.

programme.title: Los Sarrios De Plan
programme.desc: En este episodio el equipo de Paco León se desplaza a Castañar de Ibor (Cáceres, Extremadura), para asistir a una montería con la sociedad de cazadores local. Además de disfrutar de un cazadero precioso en sierras con mucha tradición como las de Villuercas-Ibores, vivimos una jornada llena de compadreo y buen ambiente montero.

programme.title: La Barbería Ibérica T2 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Neste episódio viajamos até Maiorca para falar sobre as novidades da tecnologia nos carretos elétricos. Este tipo de carretos é usado para trabalhar a pesca de fundo, ou tipos de pesca que requerem grande profundidade. Vemos polvos, rascassos e outro tipo de espécies a picar em direto. Vamos conhecer diferentes tipos de carretos e avaliar fatores como a bateria, capacidade e velocidade de recolha de cada um deles.

programme.title: De Montería T9 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Luis Tabares joven agricultor aficionado a la caza menor con perro, nos invita a conocer junto con su perdiguera de Burgos, uno de los cotos más bonitos que hay en la provincia de Valladolid en plenos Montes Torozos con la perdiz salvaje como protagonista.

programme.title: Caza Con Arco: Machos Monteses En El Maestrazgo
programme.desc: Neste episódio percorremos a costa da ponta norte da Ria de Arousa. Talvez, uma das zonas mais propícias para a captura de robalos de toda a península. E fazemos-no com a experiência de Iván Quintáns, pescador galego com grande reconhecimento entre os amantes da técnica do spinning.

programme.title: San Huberto Con Caza Salvaje
programme.desc: Hermanos errantes (Dropped en Inglés) es una serie de televisión de estilo documental que sigue a los hermanos Chris y Casey Keefer mientras intentan sobrevivir en zonas remotas durante 30 días. El programa pone a prueba las habilidades de caza, pesca y supervivencia de los hermanos en entornos hostiles.

programme.title: Momento Spinning: Iván Quintáns
programme.desc: Subimos por Guadalquivir desde Sanlúcar de Barrameda até Trebujena, uma povoação gaditana rodeada de vinhas, pântanos e muito próximo da foz do rio. Até Trebujena sobem uma grande variedade de espécies de água salgada, como é o caso das douradas, bailas e robalos. Todos sabemos o quão complicado é conseguir boas capturas no surfcasting mas o nossos amigos Ivan, Jose e António têm o objectivo de pescar um robalo no Guadalquivir.

programme.title: Hermanos Errantes T7 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Pescando en aguas misteriosas sigue al aventurero de pesca extrema Cyril Chauquet mientras viaja porlos cauces fluviales peligrosos y remotos en busca de algunas de las últimas especies de peces salvajes que quedan en el planeta.

programme.title: Surfcasting Em Trebujena
programme.desc: Aunque los corzos de montaña no suelen tener unos trofeos enormes su caza es todo un desafío para los recechistas. En este reportaje asistiremos de la mano de buenos 'corceros' a varios recechos del pequeño cérvido.

programme.title: American Fishing T2 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: El recocido Chef Luis Alberto Lera nos enseña cómo se encuentra la liebre de tierra de campos en la actualidad para terminar cocinando una de estas valiosas piezas al estilo tradicional donde su intenso sabor se mezcla con la vanguardia de la casa.

programme.title: Recechando Corzos De Montaña
programme.desc: Viajamos a Cáceres, cerca de Monroy, para formar parte de una gran cacería en abierto: 2.000 hectáreas y casi 700 perros. Todo un reto tanto para la logística como para la organización con 108 puestos repartidos en tres fincas de renombre por la extensión de sus manchas y por la cantidad de jabalíes que albergan. Una ocasión única en una montería especial que vivimos desde dentro.

programme.title: Salmao Truta Do Tambre
programme.desc: El podenco es una de las razas de perros más extendida entre los cazadores españoles. La talla chica se utiliza sobre todo para la caza del conejo, una de las modalidades más practicadas por los aficionados a la menor.

programme.title: Monteando Entre Los Riberos Del Tajo Y Del Río Almonte
programme.desc: O levante espanhol torna-se o verdadeiro foco da bacoreta atlântica nos meses de Verão. A voracidade dos cardumes destes atuns e os seus ataques explosivos à superfície fazem com que os pescadores procurem incessantemente os bandos de pássaros de denunciam os grupode de peixes. Acção e adrenalina a spinning nas águas mediterrânicas.

programme.title: Mario En Su Prime T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: A 'Barbearia Ibérica' desloca-se nesta ocasião para a zona alta do rio Guadalquivir. O objetivo, para aprender em primeira mão sobre a situação atual do barbo cigano em um enclave tão majestoso como a Sierra de Cazorla, Segura e Las Villas. programme.title: Bacoretas Em Chama
programme.desc: El recocido Chef Luis Alberto Lera nos enseña cómo se encuentra la liebre de tierra de campos en la actualidad para terminar cocinando una de estas valiosas piezas al estilo tradicional donde su intenso sabor se mezcla con la vanguardia de la casa.

programme.title: American Fishing T2 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Visitamos, em Deba, uma povoação de antiga tradição de pesca à baleia, situado na costa Gipuzkoana muito próxima da fronteira com Bizkaia. Vamos partilhar com Iker Aguirrezabala conhecido pescador submarino da zona e adepto da pesca à enguia. Com Iker vamos desfrutar da pesca submarina atrás dos populares sargos, e douradas.

programme.title: Lera, Sabores De La Meseta T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Em Benagéber, Mario decide voltar às suas raízes apostando numa pesca mais dinâmica e tradicional junto a Juan DoMarco. Um episódio que reivindica a pesca ativa e o estilo clássico em frente à dependência da tecnologia.

programme.title: Hermanos Errantes T7 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Arranca una nueva temporada montera. 'De Montería' estrena nueva época y nuevo equipo, con más pasión que nunca recorriendo España para mostrar por dentro la modalidad reina de la caza mayor. Empezamos con una montería en las dehesas toledanas donde los gamos son los protagonistas, ofreciendo lances espectaculares.

programme.title: Pesca Nos Fiordes Noruegueses
programme.desc: Visitamos, em Deba, uma povoação de antiga tradição de pesca à baleia, situado na costa Gipuzkoana muito próxima da fronteira com Bizkaia. Vamos partilhar com Iker Aguirrezabala conhecido pescador submarino da zona e adepto da pesca à enguia. Com Iker vamos desfrutar da pesca submarina atrás dos populares sargos, e douradas.

programme.title: Pescando Em Águas Misteriosas T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Hermanos errantes (Dropped en Inglés) es una serie de televisión de estilo documental que sigue a los hermanos Chris y Casey Keefer mientras intentan sobrevivir en zonas remotas durante 30 días. El programa pone a prueba las habilidades de caza, pesca y supervivencia de los hermanos en entornos hostiles.

programme.title: Pesca Submarina Em Deba
programme.desc: Chegamos a Córdoba para conhecer mais sobre a pesca com método livre, uma modalidade que tem cada vez mais adeptos. Antonio Cobos vai-nos mostrar todos os detalhes desta técnica, cevadouros, engodos, iscos e tudo o que é necessário para desfrutar de grandes jornadas de pesca. Carpas e barbos não resistem aos nossos pescadores, com várias picadas destas maravilhosas espécies.

programme.title: Wild Luis: Corzos De Montaña
programme.desc: Alberto Mera e Alberto López são dois companheiros na pesca à mosca muito conhecidos na Galiza pela sua especial habilidade na confecão das suas próprias moscas. Ambos partilham um particular interesse pela pesca do salmão truta. É na zona intermareal do rio Tombre, na Corunha, onde passam alguns dos seus melhores momentos juntos desfrutando da sua paixão. Experiências que decidiram partilhar com todos os espetadores neste documentário.

programme.title: Córdoba Com Isco Livre
programme.desc: Asistimos a una montería en la finca Los Claros, una de las más emblemáticas del valle de Alcudia (Ciudad Real). Esta finca se ha hecho un nombre en el panorama montero por la calidad de sus.

programme.title: Pescando Em Águas Misteriosas T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: En el norte de Portugal, en el Geoparque Tierra de Caballeros, las monterías tienen un sabor especial. Muchas personas y una verdadera fiesta cinegética, conservando una forma muy peculiar de hacer la montería y todo lo que la rodea, como subastas, yantares y un gran ambiente.

programme.title: De Montería T9 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Tanto la altaneria como el bajo vuelo exige una buena compenetración entre ave y cetrero. En este reportaje conoceremos los secretos de una modalidad que es patrimonio de la humanidad.

programme.title: Lances Monteros En Tierra De Caballeros
programme.desc: Andy conhece Jerry, um guia de pesca e uma lenda local, num couto do centro da Escócia. Jerry domina as melhores zonas e as moscas que se deven usar nesta época do ano. Juntos vão capturar as tão apreciadas e lutadoras trutas além de outras surpresas.

programme.title: De Poder A Poder
programme.desc: Luis de la Torriente viaja a tierras gallegas para cazar corzos y empaparse con la cultura y gatronomía.

programme.title: Fresh Fish, Escocia T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Nueva aventura de los Certeros bellesteros, en esta ocasión con un 'dos por uno' disfrutado en Ciudad Real. Este grupo de amigos viaja a Castilla La Mancha durante un completo fin de semana donde se consiguen dos ejemplares a rececho:Jose abate un corzo y su hermano Chico consigue un macho montés, una especie con la que llevaba años soñando. Todo aderezado con la buena camardería y las risas de estos cazadores.

programme.title: Wild Luis: El Corzo Galaico
programme.desc: Las diferentes administraciones autonomicas permiten la caza de difrentes especies fuera de la temporada general de caza debido al sobre todo al daño que causan a la agricultura. En este reportaje los jabalies serán los protagonistas de la mano de dos buenos aficionados a su caza.

programme.title: Pioneros Do Coup Em Mar
programme.desc: Mudamo-nos para a zona de Sevilha seguindo os passos do nosso barbo cigano. Nesta ocasião, contamos com a ajuda inestimável de Luis Guerrero, um dos melhores pescadores de mosca do mundo. como objetivo prioritário os nossos barbos andaluzes. A nossa viagem continua pela parte norte do Guadalquivir, desta vez nas águas do rio Montoro, onde com um pouco de esforço e dedicação, conseguimos Contato com os barbelos deste belo lugar.

programme.title: La Barbería Ibérica T2 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Começamos a nossa reportagem em Palmones, uma pequena localidade pertencente aos Barrios (Algeciras) onde temos à espera Andrés, um grande amigo e grande pescador de jigging da zona. Vamos navagar até Tarifa à procura dos grandes peixes dos fundos do Atlântico, o mero, o pargo e o dentão. O rei e os principes dos fundos.

programme.title: Top Water T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Argentina es uno de los países con mayores poblaciones de tórtolas y palomas de todo el mundo. Se cazan practicamente todos los meses del año. Los dorados, peces de agua dulce son otro de los atractivos del país americano.

programme.title: Carpas De Valmayor
programme.desc: Alex Castell, el jefe de la famosa cuadriila jabalinera de Arén, deja los jabalíes por unos días para vivir una de las jornadas de caza más duras de su historia, la del chamois alpino. Junto a otro amigo cazador, ambos viajan a los Alpes franceses, casi en Mónaco, para intentar abatir sendos ejemplares de rebeco.

programme.title: Camurça, A Rainha Dos Cumes - Ep. 138
programme.desc: A voz da experiência. Desconfiadas, esquivas, com um grande olfato, boa visão e uma audição extraordinária. Trepadoras excecionais. Verdadeiras acrobatas. Ágeis e velozes, deslocam-se entre penhascos, encostas e declives como se nada tivesse acontecido. Não é por acaso que a camurça é a rainha dos picos. A sua caça é um verdadeiro desafio físico a todos os níveis.

Apresentada por Rafa Carrillo, viajaremos por Espanha para tentar ajudar no controlo da população desta espécie. Seremos testemunhas dos danos que causam, falaremos com as pessoas que são afetadas diretamente e com os responsáveis pela tomada de decisões, para fazer face aos problemas que causam.

programme.title: Brama Zamorana - Ep. 2
programme.desc: A pausa. Brama zamorana é a emocionante crónica da vibrante caça ao veado ibérico através das experiências de sete caçadores diferentes. Um espetáculo de sons e emoções vivido a partir do interior, repleto de lances frenéticos com carabina e arco ao ritmo dos bramidos que invadem a floresta. Apreciar as demonstrações de poder e os rituais de lutas dos poderosos machos que se tornarão nos objetivos das nossas aproximações.

programme.title: Temporada De Caça - Ep. 128
programme.desc: Febre do lagópode da Lapónia 3. programme.title: Cozinhas À Medida T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Uma cozinha que parece conter várias: zona de confeção, lavandaria, área de refeições e até um espaço para televisão, tudo pensado ao detalhe para aproveitar cada recanto sem comprometer a fluidez e o conforto. O desafio? Incluir todas estas funções num espaço limitado, mantendo a estética leve e organizada.

programme.title: Cozinhas À Medida T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Pensada de raiz, esta cozinha minimalista combina estética limpa com funcionalidade inteligente. A madeira clara traz conforto, a luz natural é aproveitada ao máximo, e cada solução, desde a arrumação invisível aos eletrodomésticos embutidos, tudo contribui para um espaço eficiente, sereno e pronto a viver.

programme.title: Ó Da Casa T1 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: A brincadeira e a leitura estão em destaque neste Ó da Casa. A pensar nos momentos de lazer, a apresentadora Joana Laranjeira ensina a construir uma parede de escalada e uns suportes para livros, mesmo à medida das crianças lá de casa.

programme.title: Ó Da Casa T1 - Ep. 8

programme.title: Ó Da Casa T1 - Ep. 9

programme.title: Constrói O Teu Castelo T1 - Ep. 6

programme.title: Cozinhas À Medida T1 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Neste episódio, partimos de uma base sólida para fazer afinações subtis, mas transformadoras. A nova ilha, o uso da madeira e a integração de materiais elegantes como a pedra redefiniram o espaço, agora mais sereno, funcional e caloroso.

programme.title: Constrói O Teu Castelo T1 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Com os primeiros hóspedes da época prestes a chegar, a piscina continua a ser um pesadelo para Mandy e Steve. À medida que tentam terminá-la a tempo, surgem tempestades e novos atrasos fazem com que pareça que nunca conseguirão deixar a mansão pronta a tempo.

programme.title: Pastelaria Para Todos T1 - Ep. 3

programme.title: The Contractor: Mercenário
programme.desc: Após ser dispensado das Forças Especiais do Exército e perder a pensão e o seguro de saúde, James Harper, endividado e com a família para sustentar, assina contrato com a uma equipa militar privada. Só que quando primeira missão corre mal, ele torna-se um alvo a abater.

programme.title: Há Dias De Azar…
programme.desc: Um erro de identificação coloca Slevin no meio de uma guerra travada pelos dois líderes da máfia nova-iorquina. Perseguido por um assassino profissional e sob intensa vigilância do detetive Brikowski, ele terá que encontrar uma forma de escapar com vida da confusão em que entrou...

programme.title: The Reckoning - O Derradeiro Julgamento
programme.desc: A Grande Peste espalhou no país um clima de medo, desconfiança e morte. Grace, uma jovem viúva, é falsamente acusada de bruxaria pelo senhorio depois deste a tentar forçar a pagar as dívidas com favores sexuais. Levada para a prisão, ela enfrentará a mais cruel tortura, mas não estará sozinha...

programme.title: Henrique V
programme.desc: No decorrer da Guerra dos Cem Anos, o jovem rei Henrique V de Inglaterra lidera o seu exército na luta contra França em 1415.

programme.title: Os Três Mosqueteiros
programme.desc: Ao lado de um jovem recruta ansioso por proteger o Rei de França, três leais espadachins tentam derrotar o pérfido conselheiro real e a sedutora espia enviada para derrubar a coroa.

programme.title: O Espaço Que Nos Une
programme.desc: O primeiro humano nascido em Marte viaja à Terra pela primeira vez aos 16 anos e vive extasiado todas maravilhas do planeta. Quando foge dos seus protetores e parte em busca do pai, segue viagem com a rapariga por quem se apaixonou mas que não sabe a verdade sobre ele.

programme.title: Antes Do Adeus
programme.desc: Nick e Brooke são dois estranhos retidos em Manhattan durante a noite, que vão gradualmente tornar-se confidentes um do outro. À medida que as horas passam, o inesperado acontece e eles acabam por ser forçados a confrontar os seus medos e assumir o controlo das suas vidas.

programme.title: Um Dia A Casa Vem Abaixo
programme.desc: Após ser desalojado de um apartamento de Manhattan, o casal Walter e Anna consegue comprar uma casa que parece ser verdadeiramente de sonho… exceto pelo fato de estar quase literalmente a cair aos bocados. Conseguirá a relação sobreviver a uma casa prestes a vir abaixo?

programme.title: Jogo De Risco
programme.desc: Richie Furst financia as suas propinas da faculdade a jogar póquer na internet. Quando um dia é vigarizado, viaja até à Costa Rica para confrontar o responsável, Ivan Block, mas acaba por ser integrado na operação e viver uma vida de luxo, sem ter a noção do nível de ilegalidade que está a cometer.

programme.title: Eliminators: Fugir ou Morrer
programme.desc: Um antigo agente federal tem de abandonar o programa de proteção de testemunhas quando a sua casa é invadida por engano. Quando volta a ser perseguido por um perigoso assassino, tem de fugir com a filha e garantir a sua segurança antes de ser apanhado!

programme.title: Greenland O Último Refúgio
programme.desc: Uma família luta pela sobrevivência quando um cometa destruidor de planetas chega à Terra. John Garrity, a sua ex-mulher e o seu filho fazem uma perigosa viagem até à sua derradeira esperança de salvação, à medida que a contagem decrescente para o apocalipse global se aproxima do zero.

programme.title: Snitch - Infiltrado
programme.desc: Com o filho adolescente injustamente acusado de tráfico de droga, John Matthews faz um acordo para trabalhar numa perigosa missão como informador infiltrado junto de traficantes, arriscando tudo, incluindo a família e a própria vida.

programme.title: Fora de Controlo
programme.desc: Thomas Craven é um veterano da polícia que investiga o homicídio da própria filha, na sequência do qual descobre uma conspiração empresarial e governamental de proporções inesperadas.

programme.title: Safe - O Intocável
programme.desc: Mei é uma jovem de memória prodigiosa que tem na cabeça um código numérico que a leva a ser perseguia pelas tríades chinesas, a máfia russa e polícias corruptos de Nova Iorque. Em seu auxílio surge um ex-polícia caído em desgraça que não se vai deter perante nada para a proteger..

programme.title: Matando Salazar
programme.desc: Uma equipa de elite de agentes de combate à droga tem por missão proteger um barão do narcotráfico num hotel de luxo. Enquanto aguardam pela extração do criminoso, veem-se no centro de uma emboscada quando os antigos associados do traficante lançam um ataque cerrado ao local.

programme.title: Brimstone - Castigo
programme.desc: No velho Oeste, a jovem muda Liz vive com o marido e os filhos, mas a sua vida vai mudar de forma radical com a chegada de um novo pastor à comunidade, obsessivo e violento, que leva a que ela rapidamente perceba que a sua família vai correr um enorme perigo.

programme.title: Sin City: Mulher Fatal
programme.desc: Alguns dos cidadãos mais duros e resistentes da brutal metrópole que é Sin City cruzam-se com alguns dos seus habitantes mais sanguinários, em histórias de vingança e redenção.

programme.title: Vencer A Qualquer Preço
programme.desc: Um jornalista irlandês da área desportiva tem a forte suspeita de que as prestações do ciclista Lance Armstrong nas vitórias da Volta à França foram conseguidas à base de substâncias proibidas, o que o leva a procurar pistas que hão de revelar toda a verdade sobre o atleta.

programme.title: Um Dia A Casa Vem Abaixo
programme.desc: Após ser desalojado de um apartamento de Manhattan, o casal Walter e Anna consegue comprar uma casa que parece ser verdadeiramente de sonho… exceto pelo fato de estar quase literalmente a cair aos bocados. Conseguirá a relação sobreviver a uma casa prestes a vir abaixo?

programme.title: Cidade Sob Ameaça
programme.desc: Após ter provocado acidentalmente um grave acidente ao seu parceiro, o agente Jim Dillon jura nunca mais pegar numa arma, até ao dia em que um grupo de violentos motards invade a cidade onde ele é marshall e não lhe resta outra opção senão confrontar os fantasmas do seu passado para a defender.

programme.title: As Rainhas Do Desconto
programme.desc: Uma dona de casa aborrecida e frustrada, Connie Kaminski, e a sua melhor amiga JoJo Johnson, uma “vlogger” com muitos sonhos, criam um esquema de cupões de desconto que lhes vai valer vários milhões de dólares e muitas dores de cabeça.

programme.title: Alguém Tem Que Ceder
programme.desc: Harry Langer é um homem de meia idade que tem namoradas muito mais jovens mas que, quando tem um ataque cardíaco, acaba por ficar ao cuidado de Erica, a mãe da sua última namorada-troféu. Só que embora inicialmente eles se detestem, o inesperado acaba por acontecer…

programme.title: Projeto 725
programme.desc: A filha do CEO de uma empresa de tecnologia é raptada por um grupo terrorista que pretende roubar o poderoso programa informático “Projeto 725” para causar estragos por todo o mundo. No meio do caos, só um destemido grupo de mercenários poderá evitar o pior…

programme.title: Preto Ou Branco
programme.desc: Elliott Anderson, recentemente viúvo, fica responsável por cuidar da neta mas é levado a tribunal pela avó paterna, que quer obter a custódia da criança, obrigando as duas famílias a confrontarem-se com os medos e convicções mais profundos no que respeita a raça, perdão e compreensão.

programme.title: Mile 22
programme.desc: Uma pequena equipa de elite de oficiais americanos, parte de uma unidade operações especiais e secretas, tem por missão levar para fora da Indonésia um misterioso agente da polícia com informações sensíveis.

programme.title: Aeroporto
programme.desc: Mel Bakersfeld é o responsável pelas operações do Aeroporto Internacional de Chicago, que tenta manter em funcionamento durante uma devastadora tempestade de neve, ao mesmo tempo que um bombista suicida ameaça rebentar um Boeing 707 em pleno voo.

programme.title: Um Traidor Dos Nossos
programme.desc: Um casal de férias em Marraquexe vê-se envolvido nos planos de um oligarca russo para desertar para o ocidente. Entre a mafia russa e os serviços secretos britânicos, o casal é obrigado a fazer uma perigosa viagem por Paris, Berna e pelos cantos mais obscuros da cidade de Londres.

programme.title: Instinto Predador
programme.desc: Um navio grego transporta animais exóticos perigosos da Amazónia, incluindo um raro jaguar branco. Nessa mesma embarcação, um assassino, que estava a ser extraditado em segredo para os EUA, consegue fugir e libertar todos os animais em cativeiro, deixando os tripulantes em perigo de vida.

programme.title: Pandemónio
programme.desc: Quando um vírus letal, capaz de tornar as pessoas extremamente violentas e selvagens, se alastra num edifício de escritórios, o advogado Derek Cho e uma cliente insatisfeita terão de unir esforços para lutar pela sobrevivência.

programme.title: Verdi - Rigoletto
programme.desc: Riccardo Frizza leads the Orchestra and Chorus of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a performance of Giuseppe Verdi’s tragic opera Rigoletto (1851). In 1850, Teatro La Fenice commissioned Verdi to compose a new opera. Verdi proposed Victor Hugo’s controversial play Le Roi s'amuse to his librettist Francesco Maria Piave.

programme.title: Waldbühne 1996 - Italian Night
programme.desc: Designed by the German architect Werner March, Berlin's Waldbühne is an amphitheater that seats over 22,000 people. It was built between 1934 and 1936 for the Summer Olympics of 1936. Since WWII, the Waldbühne has been used for a variety of events, including boxing matches, film screenings, and classical and rock concerts. Annually, the Berlin Philharmonic performs a stunning open concert.

programme.title: Discovering Masterpieces – Mozart: Symphony No. 41
programme.desc: Watch the series ‘Discovering Masterpieces'! Your audio-visual concert guide to the great masterpieces of classical music. The series brings you 20 half-hour documentaries on 20 classical masterpieces: acclaimed experts, famous soloists and outstanding conductors take you on a journey back to the time and place of composition. In today’s documentary, W. A. Mozart’s ‘Symphony No. 41’ is discussed.

programme.title: Heyward conducts Dvorák’s Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: American conductor Jonathon Heyward makes his debut with the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) with this performance of Antonín Dvorák’s beloved Symphony No. 9 in E minor, Op. 95, 'From the New World'. Composed during Dvorák’s stay in the United States, the work blends Bohemian warmth with the rhythms and spirit of American musical traditions.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Semi-finals: Duparc, Schumann a. o.
programme.desc: Baritone Geng Lee (China, 1994) and pianist Nils Basters (Germany, 1989) perform Henri Duparc’s Chanson triste; ‘Ein Jüngling liebt ein Mädchen’ and ‘Am leuchtenden Sommermorgen’ from Robert Schumann’s Dichterliebe, Op.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: German Brass goes Bach
programme.desc: The German Brass ensemble delivers some of Bach's most popular tunes in breathtaking brass arrangements. Recorded live from the magnificent St. Thomas Church in Leipzig, this concert features timeless pieces by the legendary German composer, such as Toccata and Fugue in D minor, Adagio in G minor, and Jesus bleibet meine Freude.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 1
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 1 And Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: At the age of seven, Argentine pianist Martha Argerich made her debut with Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 1 in C major, Op. 15, a piece that would accompany her throughout her career. The celebrated pianist performs this signature piece at the Lucerne Festival with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra under the baton of Swedish conductor Herbert Blomstedt, who makes his festival debut with the orchestra. programme.title: IVC 2021 - Semi-finals: Schubert, Wolf a. o.
programme.desc: Soprano Heidi Baumgartner (Austria, 1998) and pianist Asuka Tagami (Japan, 1991) perform Franz Schubert’s Suleika I, Op. 14 No. 1, D.

programme.title: Discovering Masterpieces – Debussy – La Mer
programme.desc: Watch the series ‘Discovering Masterpieces’, your audio-visual concert guide to the great masterpieces of classical music. The series brings you 20 half-hour documentaries on 20 classical masterpieces: acclaimed experts, famous soloists and outstanding conductors take you on a journey back to the time and place of composition. In today’s documentary, Claude Debussy’s ‘La Mer’.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Sonata No. 21 - III
programme.desc: Julijana Sarac performs the first/third movement of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Sonata No. 21 (“Waldstein”). The work was completed in 1804 and is considered one of Beethoven's greatest and most technically challenging piano sonatas.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Burgundian Alphabet III - De la Rue - Without name
programme.desc: Enjoy a genuine musical marathon as a prelude to the Utrecht Early Music Festival 2018. During three concerts, the Huelgas Ensemble sing an entire alphabet of Burgundian composers, one for every letter. It concerns composers who were employed by the Burgundian court, with a special exception for Josquin, prince of polyphony.

programme.title: Pierre Boulez and the Lucerne Festival Academy
programme.desc: For over six decades, Pierre Boulez had a greater influence on the development of contemporary music than anyone else. Already in his younger days, he gained a reputation as a doughty champion of the avant-garde. With his compositions, interpretations and ideas, he indelibly shaped the international music scene – not only as a composer and conductor, but also as a music philosopher and teacher.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances present Ludwig van Beethoven’s Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, ‘Eroica’.

programme.title: PIAM - Final: Beethoven and Brahms
programme.desc: Acclaimed classical music talent scout Antonio Mormone (1930-2017) lives on as the name-giver of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), awarded to the winner of the Italian music competition of the same name. The first edition of this competition, which was held in various venues in Milan from 2019 to 2021, was dedicated to the piano.

programme.title: IVC 2019 - Final: Schubert, Schumann et al.
programme.desc: Soprano Harriet Burns (United Kingdom, 1989) and pianist Ian Tindale (United Kingdom, 1990) perform Franz Schubert’s Verklärung, D. 59; Clara Schumann’s Er ist gekommen in Sturm und Regen, Op. 12, No. 2; ‘L’heure exquise’ from Reynaldo Hahn’s Chansons grises, and ‘Le printemps’ from Hahn’s Douze rondels; ‘Herzeleid’ from Robert Schumann’s Sechs Gesänge, Op.

programme.title: Verdi - Otello
programme.desc: Based on a story by William Shakespeare, the Italian composer Giuseppe Verdi wrote the opera Otello. Stage director David Alden created his version of this tragedy for the Teatro Real, in Madrid. Renato Palumbo conducts the orchestra and chorus of the Teatro Real. The performance also features Gregory Kunde, Ermonela Jaho, and George Petean. Othello, the Venetian governor of Cyprus, returns to the island after a victorious campaign.

programme.title: Chamber music by Janácek, Taffanel and Prokofiev
programme.desc: This chamber music concert is part of the ‘Solistas del Siglo XXI’ concert series of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid. First, Quinteto Zéphyros performs Leoš Janácek’s Mládí (‘Youth’) for wind sextet. This is followed by French flautist Paul Taffanel’s Wind Quintet in G minor, performed by Quinteto Scarlatti de Casa de la Moneda. The program closes with Sergei Prokofiev’s Quintet in G minor, Op. 39, played by Quinteto Cosan.

programme.title: Saint-Saëns - The Carnival of the Animals
programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Camille Saint-Saëns’s musical suite The Carnival of the Animals (Le carnaval des animaux, 1886). This suite consists of 14 movements, each depicting a different animal.

programme.title: PIAM - Semi-final I: Debussy, Chopin and Liszt
programme.desc: Acclaimed classical music talent scout Antonio Mormone (1930-2017) lives on as the name-giver of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), awarded to the winner of the Italian music competition of the same name. The first edition of this competition, which was held in various venues in Milan from 2019 to 2021, was dedicated to the piano.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Esa-Pekka Salonen
programme.desc: The Finnish composer and conductor Esa-Pekka Salonen (1958) was Music Director of the Los Angeles Philharmonic from 1992 until 2009. Under his dynamic leadership, it was recognized as one of the world's most outstanding orchestras. The exciting musical partnership Salonen established with his musicians was widely acclaimed in the international press.

programme.title: Sibelius – Symphony No. 6
programme.desc: In 2013, the Finnish conductor Hannu Lintu was appointed principal conductor of the Finnish Radio Symphony Orchestra. Lintu studied piano and cello at the Sibelius Academy and the Turku conservatorium in Sweden’s southeast. He started conducting at the Sibelius Academy.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Bruckner - Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: In a 2019 performance from the Muziekgebouw in Eindhoven, Hartmut Haenchen conducts the philharmonie zuidnederland for this performance of Anton Bruckner’s Symphony No. 7.

programme.title: Welser-Möst conducts Farrenc, Ravel And Mussorgsky
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra in a program recorded at Severance Music Center in Cleveland in March 2023. On the program are Louise Farrenc's Symphony No. 3, Ravel's Piano Concerto in G (featuring Vïkingur Ólafsson as soloist) and Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition (orchestration by Ravel).

programme.title: Schumann - Faschingsschwank aus Wien, Op. 26
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz performs Faschingsschwank aus Wien, Op. 26 (Carnival Scenes from Vienna).

programme.title: Les Bains Macabres
programme.desc: French composer Guillaume Connesson (*1970) is building an impressive musical oeuvre, to which he has recently added an opera: 'Les bains macabres'. For this romantic contemporary thriller opera he worked closely with librettist Olivier Bleys (*1970), a successful French author with dozens of novels to his credit.

programme.title: Europakonzert 1993 - Royal Albert Hall
programme.desc: Every year, the Europakonzert is hosted by the Berliner Philharmoniker in a notorious concert hall or on a special location. This years concert is performed at the magnificent Royal Albert Hall in London. The Dutch conductor Bernard Haitink starts with Tchaikovsky's Fantasy Overture from 'Roméo et Juliette'. The second piece by Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart is his famous Violin Concerto No. 3 in G major K.

programme.title: England, my England - II
programme.desc: From August 28 to September 6, 2015, the Early Music Festival Utrecht was all about 'England, my England'. In line with this theme, presenter Lex Bohlmeijer takes the viewer on an intriguing journey through the England of the Middle Ages, Renaissance and Baroque, and relates this to the city of Utrecht.

programme.title: Richard Strauss - A Hero's Life, Op. 40
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a concert performing Richard Strauss' Ein Heldenleben, Op. 40. Violin soloist is David Radzynski. Recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland in February 2023. Strauss, at the age of 34, sparked outrage when he cast himself as the central figure of his tone poem. Generally agreed to be autobiographical, the work contains more than thirty quotations from Strauss's earlier works.

programme.title: IVC 2019 - Final: Schubert, Wolf et al.
programme.desc: Soprano Erika Baikoff (United States, 1994) and pianist Gary Beecher (Ireland, 1993) perform Franz Schubert’s ‘Suleika I, Was bedeutet die Bewegung’, Op. 14, No. 1 (D. 720); Die Blumensprache, Op. 173, No. 5 (D. 519); and, Die Gebüsche, D. 646; ‘Lied vom Winde’ and ‘Der Knabe und das Immlein’ from Hugo Wolf’s Mörike-Lieder; ‘Fleur jetée’ from Gabriel Fauré’s Quatre melodies, Op.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Concerto No. 6, K 238
programme.desc: Christian Zacharias performs Mozart's Piano Concerto No. 6, K 238, accompanied by the Radio-Sinfonieorchester Stuttgart under the direction of Gianluigi Gelmetti. This concert was recorded at Schwetzingen palace, where the Mannheim elector’s court would spend their summers.

programme.title: Weinberg - Rhapsody on Moldovan Themes, Op. 47/1
programme.desc: Over the course of 19 days, the best youth orchestras in the world led by great conductors, and flanked by virtuoso soloists, guaranteed exciting and inspiring concert performances at the Young Euro Classical 2017. The festival is known to be the most important platform for international young orchestra musicians in the European classical music tradition, and for its development.

programme.title: The Galileo Project: Music of the Spheres
programme.desc: The Tafelmusik Baroque Orchestra, also known simply as Tafelmusik, is a Toronto-based Canadian baroque orchestra, specialised in early music. The ensemble is directed by violinist Jeanne Lamon. In ‘The Galileo Project: Music of the Spheres’ they perform music by Monteverdi, Vivaldi, Bach and Handel to a backdrop of high-definition images from the Hubble telescope, NASA and Canadian astronomers.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Semi-finals: Schönberg, Britten a. o.
programme.desc: Baritone Arvid Fagerfjäll (Sweden, 1991) and pianist Hikaru Kanki (Japan, 1993) perform Franz Schubert’s An mein Herz, D. 860; ‘Die Aufgeregten’ from Arnold Schönberg’s Sechs Lieder, Op. 3; ‘A poison tree’ from Benjamin Britten’s The red cockatoo and other songs; Bart Visman’s Vermeer’s Gold; ‘La mer est plus belle’ from Claude Debussy’s Trois mélodies de Paul Verlaine, L. 81; Gabriel Fauré’s Prison, Op. 83, No.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Zubin Mehta
programme.desc: Indian conductor Zubin Mehta (1936) became Music Director of the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra (IPO) in 1977 and was appointed Music Director for Life in 1981. On July 18, 1996, Mehta led the IPO in its first-ever performance of Richard Strauss’s tone poem Till Eulenspiegels lustige Streiche, Op. 28.

programme.title: PIAM - Semi-final: Mendelssohn and Chopin
programme.desc: Acclaimed classical music talent scout Antonio Mormone (1930-2017) lives on as the name-giver of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), awarded to the winner of the Italian music competition of the same name. The first edition of this competition, which was held in various venues in Milan from 2019 to 2021, was dedicated to the piano.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Israel Philharmonic Orchestra: Coming Home
programme.desc: On December 24, 2011, one of the world’s most renowned classical orchestras, the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra, celebrated the 75th anniversary of its founding. The film portrays the orchestra and its eventful history against the backdrop of Israel and the holocaust.

programme.title: Ravel - Sonata for violin and piano in G major
programme.desc: Japanese violinist Naoya Nishimura and Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti perform Maurice Ravel’s Sonata for violin and piano (No. 2) in G major, M. 77. The sonata consists of three movements. The piece is often listed as “No. 2”, yet the composer wrote his actual second sonata, which remained unpublished until 38 years after his death, before this one. This performance was recorded at the Munetsugu Hall in Nagoya, Japan.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 6 in B minor, Op. 74
programme.desc: This concert may be called a meeting of musical giants: Manfred Honeck conducts the Berlin Philharmonic while cellist Yo-Yo Ma features as soloist. Success guaranteed when these artists take the stage at the 2016 Easter Concert from the Festspielhaus in Baden-Baden! Honeck, musical director of the Pittsburgh Symphony Orchestra, made his successful debut with the Berlin Philharmonic in 2013.

programme.title: Monteverdi - Madrigals, Book III
programme.desc: Italian composer Claudio Monteverdi (1567-1643) composed nine books of madrigals in half a century, which helped transform the genre from the polyphonic, a cappella madrigals of the late Renaissance to the ‘concertato’ madrigals of the early Baroque, shifting the style’s focus to the ability of music to express emotions contained in a text.

programme.title: Piano works by Scriabin, Berg And Beethoven
programme.desc: The Italian pianist Roberto Prosseda (*1975) is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Felix Mendelssohn. Moreover, Prosseda is particularly praised for his interpretations of W. A. Mozart, Franz Schubert, Robert Schumann and Frédéric Chopin.

programme.title: Shostakovich - 24 Preludes and Fugues, Op. 87
programme.desc: English-French pianist David Levy performs Dmitri Shostakovich’s 24 Preludes and Fugues, Op. 87. The work is a set of twenty-four pieces for piano, one in each of the major and minor keys of the chromatic scale. Each piece is in two parts: a prelude followed by a fugue. The composer was doubtlessly inspired by J. S.

programme.title: Mozart - Violin Concerto No. 4
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances play Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Violin Concerto No. 4 in D major, K. 218. Leading violinist Grimal features as the soloist.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - The Nutcracker
programme.desc: This visually stunning production of Nutcracker is a graceful and timeless adventure on a grand scale. From the lovely Waltz of the Flowers to the crystalline beauty of the stunning Snowflake Waltz, each scene is more breathtaking than the last, bringing to life all the well-known and beloved characters with fresh sparkle and compelling originality.

programme.title: Baroque works by Bach, Muffat and Rameau
programme.desc: Paul Goodwin conducts the Conjunto Barroco of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid in a Baroque music program featuring works by Georg Muffat, J. S. Bach, and Jean-Philippe Rameau. On the program are Muffat’s Sonata No. 5 in G major, 'Armonico tributo'; Bach’s Orchestral Suite No. 4 in D major, BWV 1069; and Rameau’s Suite from the opera ‘Les Boréades’.

programme.title: TeoTronico - The Robot Pianist
programme.desc: TeoTronico is a pianist robot, conceived and designed by Matteo Suzzi at TeoTronica company, an Italian start-up based in Imola. Version 1.0, with 29 fingers, was completed in 2007. Starting from version 3.0 (2012), TeoTronico was implemented with 53 fingers made of dynamically driven electromagnets, able to control the gradations of any acoustic piano.

programme.title: Bellini/Liszt - Réminiscences de Norma S.394
programme.desc: Minsoo Hong (1993, South Korea) performs Liszt’s Sposalizio from Années de Pèlerinage: Deuxième Année (S161/1) and Bellini/Liszt’s Réminiscences de Norma (S394) during the Solo Finals of the11th International Franz Liszt Piano Competition, held in TivoliVredenburg, Utrecht, in 2017. The competition actively presents, develops, and promotes piano talents from around the world.

programme.title: Stravinsky - Le Sacre - II: Le Sacrifice
programme.desc: Every year, the Europakonzert is hosted by the Berliner Philharmoniker in a notorious concert hall or on a special location. This years concert is performed at the magnificent Royal Albert Hall in London. The Dutch conductor Bernard Haitink closes with Stravinsky's The Rite of Spring which he wrote in 1913 for Sergei Diaghilev's Ballets Russes.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Gluck - Iphigénie en Tauride
programme.desc: Iphigénie en Tauride (1779) is a four-act tragic opera by German-born composer Christoph Willibald Gluck. Written for the French stage, the work’s premiere in 1779 at the Parisian Royal Academy of Music was a great success. Iphigénie en Tauride is one of the composer’s ‘reform operas’, meaning that the music was to follow the drama and its expression.

programme.title: Brahms - Tragic Overture in D minor Op. 81
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy’s oldest opera and arts festival. It was founded in 1933 with the aim of presenting contemporary and forgotten operas. Over the years, the scope widened, and orchestral concerts have long been an integral part of the festival.

programme.title: Schubert - String Quartet No. 15 in G major
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents.

programme.title: Beethoven - Fidelio, Op. 72
programme.desc: Fidelio (originally titled 'Leonore, oder Der Triumph der ehelichen Liebe,' which translates to 'Leonore, or the Triumph of Marital Love'), Op. 72, is Ludwig van Beethoven's only opera. This 2018 opera film from the Swiss Theater St. Gallen is based on Jan Schmidt-Garre's highly acclaimed stage production of Beethoven's Fidelio. Otto Tausk conducts the Sinfonieorchester and choir of St.

programme.title: Waldbühne 2000 - Rhythm and Dance
programme.desc: The annual summer concert given by the Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra at the Waldbühne is a legendary event. The Millenium concert, recorded live on June 25, 2000, brought together more than 22,000 spectators in one of Europe's most beautiful outdoor amphitheaters.

programme.title: Documentary: Gianandrea Noseda
programme.desc: Although the great Italian composer Giuseppe Verdi applied unsuccessfully to study at the Milan Conservatory, this renowned college of music was eventually named after him. Today, the ‘Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi’ counts numerous successful musicians among its alumni: from Giacomo Puccini, Alfredo Catalani, Claudio Abbado, Riccardo Chailly, Luigi Einaudi and Daniele Gatti, to Gianandrea Noseda.

programme.desc: Os dois encontram-se pela primeira vez numa reunião de grupo para viciados em sexo. Ele é Javier, talentoso roteirista e produtor de cinema, que está preso a uma relação doentia, por telefone, com uma mulher misteriosa que lhe conta as suas aventuras sexuais.

No Dão, na Quinta da Boavista, João Tavares de Pina guarda uma visão rara: a de um vinho que nasce da terra viva, da memória e da resistência.

programme.title: Minha Terra Minha Gente
programme.desc: “Minha Terra, Minha Gente” apresenta o melhor dos 308 concelhos do território, através da tradição, da inovação e da sustentabilidade. Memórias das pessoas e dos locais, para as gerações futuras, com testemunhos marcantes e inspiradores de gente apaixonada: usos, costumes e tradições do rico património de Portugal. .

programme.title: Intercidades
programme.desc: O Intercidades é a nova viagem regional de fim de tarde do Conta Lá, conduzida por Rita Ferro Rodrigues, em estúdio, e uma vasta equipa de repórteres sempre em movimento pelas regiões. O programa distingue-se pelo olhar atento ao país, ligando estúdio e território em tempo real. O comboio vai parar nos vários concelhos e levar-nos até quem faz cada localidade — do café à escola, do campo à praça.

programme.title: Aventura À Flor Da Pele T5 - Ep. 5

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 48
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: Camilla George - jazzahead!
programme.desc: Annual trade fair, exhibition, and festival jazzahead! is one of the international jazz community's most important events. Hosted in Bremen, Germany, jazzahead! brings together musicians, bookers, agents, organizers, jazz experts, and music enthusiasts. Due to COVID-19, only half of the scheduled performances of the 2021 edition were actually recorded in Bremen.

programme.title: Jazzed Out Swiss
programme.desc: Jazzed Out proves that a jazz session can take place anywhere. Unusual locations, such as garage buildings, multi-storey car parks, street corners, subway trains, and parks, in several of the world’s metropoles, provide the setting for brief jazz performances. The sheer rawness of the metropoles merge with the musical creations of various artists in search of the perfect ‘urban stage’.

programme.title: Winter 1980: Maynard Ferguson Big Band in Brussels
programme.desc: The Brussels Jazz Club was filled to the brim with both musicians and audience members when the Maynard Ferguson Big Band performed there during their Winter Tour of 1980. From the first notes of the cover of Weather Report’s “Birdland” that opens the performance to the final notes of “Gonna Fly Now” that closes it, Ferguson gives his young sidemen ample time to shine.

programme.title: Lucia Cadotsch: Speak Low - November Music
programme.desc: The annual international festival November Music was first held in 1993. Since then, the festival has been promoting contemporary music across various locations in the Netherlands city ‘s-Hertogenbosch. Its 2018 edition included jazz, avant-garde, world, and electronic music, sound installations, modern opera and theatre, as well as various interdisciplinary performances.

programme.title: M.Eilertsen Trio And Trio Mediaeval - November Music
programme.desc: The annual international festival November Music was first held in 1993. Since then, the festival has been promoting contemporary music across various locations in the Netherlands city ‘s-Hertogenbosch. Its 2018 edition included jazz, avant-garde, world and electronic music, sound installations, modern opera and theatre, as well as various interdisciplinary performances.

programme.title: Under the Surface - Live at Bimhuis 2018
programme.desc: Under the Surface is an improvisational jazz band formed by drummer Joost Lijbaart, vocalist Sanne Rambags, and guitarist Bram Stadhouders. Sanne Rambags, the youngest artist of the trio, is one of the few vocalists of her generation who able to improvise effortlessly, be it by using her voice as an instrument blending with the sounds of the band, or by performing her own poetry.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Terrasson And Belmondo: À Nous Garo
programme.desc: Every year, the Jazz en Baie festival takes place in the beautiful bay of Mont Saint-Michel Today’s broadcast shows a special gathering between two grandmasters of French jazz: pianist Jacky Terrasson and trumpeter Stéphane Belmondo. The two team up for an amazing concert in which jazz is combined with soul and a touch of chanson française.

programme.title: Lex Jasper Trio: Happy Days Are Here Again
programme.desc: Lex Jasper Trio: Happy Days Are Here Again - the title says is all… After an automobile accident and 15 years of revalidation, he is back! Together with his musical pals Edwin Corzilius (double bass) and Frits Landesbergen (drums), pianist and composer Lex Jasper celebrates his return to jazz club The Duke in the Dutch village of Nistelrode.

programme.title: The Hammond© Sessions: Dede Priest
programme.desc: The Dutch Hammond organ player Rob Mostert develops, in cooperation with Stingray DJAZZ, the program Mostert Meets. In this series, the Hammond B3 organ takes center stage. Rob Mostert invites the world’s finest jazz musicians for a musical collaboration, in which the Hammond Organ plays a major role.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips

programme.title: Sly Johnson And Nicholas V. - Tribute to Marvin Gaye
programme.desc: For 20 years, Sly Johnson, author, composer and performer of the Saïan Supa Crew, has been touring the French music scene with his soul, hip-hop and beat-box vocals. He leaves his machines in the studio for a tribute concert to one of the leading voices of the famous Motown label, Marvin Gaye. The singer was killed by his father, a pastor, the day before his 45th birthday.

programme.title: Carla Bley Sextet live at Estival Lugano 1986
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Discover the special bond between pianist Carla Bley and bassist Steve Swallow.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Hypnotic Brass Ensemble
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s BIRD is a club, café, and restaurant with a live music program that's deeply rooted in jazz, soul, funk, hip-hop, and electronic. Its name BIRD refers to the nickname of legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker. BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, fine wines, no-nonsense beers, and an all-round metropolitan rawness. Since 2014, this urban jazz club and DJAZZ.

programme.title: Jazz a` Vienne 2017
programme.desc: Watch the performance of Jamie Cullum live at Jazz à Vienne, in 2017.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Marcus Miller
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Caravan
programme.desc: The legendary hard-bop group Art Blakey's Jazz Messengers performed in Olympia Hall in Paris, France on March 16, 1963. Led by drummer Art Blakey, the Jazz Messengers consisted of Wayne Shorter on tenor saxophone, Freddie Hubbard on trumpet, Curtis Fuller on trombone, Reggie Workman on double bass, and Cedar Walton on piano. Each of these players became jazz legends in their own right.

programme.title: Bass solo
programme.desc: The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument. Combining intricate harmonics, fluid melodies, and unparalleled technical skill, Pastorius left a lasting impact on the music world.

programme.title: Sarah Vaughan - Maria
programme.desc: Arguably the greatest lady vocalists of all time are featured in this superb compilation. These historic recordings from the 1950s and 1960s offer a unique overview of different approaches to jazz singing that helped define the genre. Watch Billie Holiday’s performance of “God Bless The Child” closely and learn what made her such an influential jazz and pop singer.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: John Lee Hooker Live in Paris
programme.desc: In this 1970 performance at Maison de la Radio in Paris, France, American blues legend John Lee Hooker (voice and guitar) is joined by the masterful Carey Bell (harmonica), Joe Harper (bass), Lester Dorsie (drums), and Jimmy Dawkins (electric guitar).

programme.title: Paradox Live: Bertus Borgers And The Young Retro's
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox.

programme.title: Tango Extremo: Tango on the Tundra
programme.desc: Five musicians, in excess of 3000 miles, nine concerts, in thirteen days: in November 2015, the five-piece ensemble ‘Tango Extremo’ left the confines of its hometown, the Dutch city of The Hague, to travel through Russia. On the musicians’ jam-packed itinerary were performances in Moscow, Novosibirsk, Saratov, Tomsk, and Barnaul.

programme.title: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Jazz à Vienne is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981, it has attracted a mix of jazz legends and exciting newcomers, with many of them playing return engagements. Each year welcomes outstanding international stars to the historical Le Théâtre Antique to impress and inspire their audiences.

programme.title: Long Tall Dex: Dexter Gordon Live in '63 And '64
programme.desc: Dexter Gordon: Live in '63 And '64 features three concerts filmed in 1963 and 1964 in Holland, Switzerland and Belgium that highlight the bebop legend's classic style and silky tone. Filmed while Dexter was living in Europe, these shows feature legendary side musicians such as Art Taylor (drums) and Kenny Drew (piano) and jazz classics ‘Blues Walk’, ‘A Night In Tunisia’, ‘Body And Soul’ and others.

programme.title: Kurhaus Scheveningen: Beets And Rosenwinkel
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who has a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: Aki Rissanen Trio at Jazzclub Unterfahrt, Munich
programme.desc: Aki Rissanen's interest in jazz came after he started taking classical piano lessons. His deep interest in improvised music placed him among top jazz pianist in his home country - Finland. While composing and performing his own music, Rissanen has also collaborated with Verneri Pohjola and Dave Liebman, and today his name appears among the top European jazz musicians.

programme.title: Christian McBride - John Day
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn’ at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, RAndB, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical.

programme.title: Sarah Vaughan 'The Divine One' in 1958
programme.desc: Sarah Vaughan: Live in '58 And 64 features the Divine One in her prime, wrapping her sultry voice around jazz standards such as “Lover Man”, “Misty”, and “I Got Rhythm” and popular showtunes such as “Over The Rainbow” and “Maria”. One of the greatest voices of the 20th Century, her renditions of songs by Harold Arlen, Leonard Bernstein, Johnny Burke, the Gershwins, and Stephen Sondheim are pure diva magic.

programme.title: Jimmy Witherspoon Quartet And Rozaa Wortham 1985
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Jimmy Witherspoon and Rozaa Wortham, two incredible brilliant jazz musicians. Rozaa Wortham starts off the show with the Jimmy Witherspoon Quartet.

programme.title: The Streets of London: Jazz in The City
programme.desc: Short Documentary about Jazz in The City: London.

programme.title: Tour De Force
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.

programme.title: Along came Betty
programme.desc: This broadcast is the first part of a concert performed by Art Blakey and the Jazz Messengers, recorded at the The´a^tre des Champs Elyse´es in Paris in December 1959. Co-founded in the early 1950s by American jazz drummer Art Blakey and pianist Horace Silver, this hard bop ensemble performed and recorded until Blakey died in 1990.

programme.title: Things to Come
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.

programme.title: Runtown - La Machine de Moulin Rouge
programme.desc: Enjoy Runtown’s first concert in Paris, where the Nigerian superstar brings many guests to his show. One of the most talented Nigerian afrobeat scenes will make you rediscover his greatest hits. Nigeria is a very creative country when it comes to the music scene. Runtown is no exception. His first single, “Party Like It’s 1980,” paved the way for “Gallardo,” which caught the entire international scene's attention.

programme.title: BIRD - The Nest
programme.desc: Five promising musicians get together in Rotterdam jazz club BIRD’s artists-in-residence project “The Nest”. Over the course of seven sessions, these talents exchange ideas, work on their projects, and play music together. Following this period, during which record producer Jameszoo and music manager Jochem Tromp offer their coaching experience, BIRD and North Sea Jazz Festival’s fringe festival DownTown organize a tryout performance.

programme.title: PC Qwintett: 75th year of Courbois
programme.desc: Pierre Courbois has been one of Europe’s leading jazz musicians since the mid-sixties. This concert, recorded at the renowned Amsterdam jazz club Bimhuis, sees the drummer playing with his QWINTETT. On the occasion of his 75th birthday in 2015, Courbois hit the road for the Pierre Courbois 75 Years Anniversary Tour.

programme.title: Belgium Sessions: Saxkartel
programme.desc: In this DJAZZ.tv Belgium Sessions performance, which was recorded at AED Studios in Lint, Belgium, we witness Europe’s finest jazz musicians at work. A wide variety of international jazz musicians give a creative, up-close and inside insight into their art of playing jazz music. Young talent and established jazz musicians play to their heart’s content: take for instance this unusual performance by Saxkartel.

programme.title: Elliot Galvin Trio - November Music
programme.desc: The annual international festival November Music was first held in 1993. Since then, the festival has been promoting contemporary music across various locations in the Netherlands city ‘s-Hertogenbosch. Its 2018 edition included jazz, avant-garde, world and electronic music, sound installations, modern opera and theatre, as well as various interdisciplinary performances.

programme.title: Panorama do Choro - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the bands taking part in this series is Panorama de Coro. This ensemble combines jazz and traditional Brazilian music.

programme.title: After You've Gone
programme.desc: To celebrate the release of Django, the Parisian New Morning Club pays tribute to the legendary guitarist Django Reinhardt. The program showcases the magic of Reinhardt’s compositions, as well as the virtuosity of one of his most famous heirs: Stochelo Rosenberg. With unbridled passion and enthusiasm, Rosenberg interprets the music that marked French musical heritage: gypsy jazz.

programme.title: Burton And Ozone - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Saluzzi, Mariano And Dauner live in Stuttgart
programme.desc: Dino Saluzzi, one of Argentina's tango music masters, has been building his legacy since the mid-1980s. His accordion-like bandoneon defines Argentina's tango music. Saluzzi has explored many paths—paths along which he has rarely travelled more than once, despite some common threads.

programme.title: North Sea Jazz Club: Marnix Busstra Band
programme.desc: Guitarist, composer and director Marnix Busstra loves crossing borders. He travels the world with his jazz bands, plays guitar and bouzouki, writes jazz and theatre-songs, and co-creates and directs the exuberant theatre shows of his wife, the Dutch diva Karin Bloemen. Busstra is a constant wheel of invention, with technique expanded by his creative urge to find something new, an evolving state that adds immeasurably to his art.

programme.title: Sven Hammond: 10th Year Anniversary Concert
programme.desc: The band Sven Hammond used to be known as Sven Hammond Soul. But the members have remained the same, with Ivan Peroti (vocals), Sven Figee (hammond/keys), Tim Eijmaal (guitar), Glenn Gaddum Jr. (bass) and Joost Kroon (drums). Sven Hammond creates greasy funk and soul, featuring hammond grooves, pop and jazz. This steaming music and show machine is headed by Sven Figee, who prefers to attack rather than play his Hammond organ.

programme.title: Stift Festival: Suite del Ángel
programme.desc: Late August is traditionally the time for the annual Stift International Music Festival. Weerselo’s Stift Church and Oldenzaal’s ‘Hofkerk’ serve as venues for wonderful concerts of various young musicians from all over the world. The theme of the 2014 Stift Festival was “Divine and Demonic Passion”. Young musicians performed divine and demonic chamber music by composers such as Astor Piazzolla.

programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. programme.title: The Morgenland Festival: I Will Not Be Sad
programme.desc: Since 2005, the Morgenland Festival, held in Osnabrueck, has dedicated itself to the fascinating music culture of the Near and Middle East. From traditional and classical music to avant-garde, jazz, and rock, the festival program also features art, such as visual arts, dance, and theatre of interdisciplinary projects. Jivan Gasparyan Jr has always been inspired by the folk melodies of his native Armenia.

programme.title: Buana, Buana, King Kong
programme.desc: This broadcast shows a rare appearance at the 1996 Germeringer Jazztage by the legendary flamenco guitarist Paco de Lucía and his sextet. Some may question the inclusion of a flamenco guitarist within a jazz festival.

programme.title: Charles Mingus And Eric Dolphy live in Liège
programme.desc: Charles Mingus showcases an exceptional concert performed in April 1965 featuring his most celebrated lineup: Jaki Byard (piano), Dannie Richmond (drums), Johnny Coles (trumpet), Clifford Jordan (tenor sax) and the great Eric Dolphy (alto sax, flute and bass clarinet).

programme.title: Ellen Pels - Love 1/2
programme.desc: Dutch jazz singer Ellen Pels presents her latest release, “Love.” Recorded live at Theater Odeon in Zwolle, the Netherlands, Ellen is joined by The Red Limo String Quartet and her own nine-piece rhythm section. The singer combines her passionate love for music with her own, stirring lyrics, inspired by spiritual philosophers like Paulo Coelho, Eckhard Tolle, and Deepak Chopra.

programme.title: Tamara Murphy - Spirograph Studies
programme.desc: Spirograph Studies have leapt onto the Australian music scene with their detailed, textural approach to playing improvised music. Post-rock, post-jazz and post-minimalism, they shamelessly steal sonic palettes from all areas to build their cinematic sound. This collaborative group features Luke Howard (piano), Fran Swinn (guitar) and James McLean (drums).

programme.title: Tribute to Django Reinhardt: Rosenberg meets Beets
programme.desc: World-class Dutch jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson, and John Clayton. His mother a music teacher and his father an Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey enthusiast, Beets was surrounded by music from an early age.

programme.title: Belgium Sessions: Hijaz
programme.desc: In this DJAZZ Belgium Sessions performance, which was recorded at AED Studios in Lint, Belgium, we witness Europe’s finest jazz musicians at work. A wide variety of international jazz musicians give a creative, up-close and inside insight into their art of playing jazz music. Young talent and established jazz musicians play to their heart’s content: take for instance this unusual performance by the multi-ethnic ensemble Hijaz.

programme.title: Benny Goodman Septet - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. Back in 1982, legendary jazz clarinettist Benny Goodman performed at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague with his septet.

programme.title: Kenny Barron, Song for Abdullah
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron’s June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine’s Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet).

programme.title: TorTube: Dual City Concert Band ft. Hermine Deurlo
programme.desc: Jazz fans in television land have come to the right place for their dose of first-rate world jazz: TorTube! Jazz club De Tor in Enschede is one of Europe’s most authentic jazz venues, with an absolutely unique ambiance. Some of the best musicians from Holland and the rest of the world find their way to De Tor to perform for an appreciative audience of jazz fans.

programme.title: Herbie Man And Sonny Sharrock - Memphis underground
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends’ unique essence. Revel in Wes Montgomery’s virtuosity as he performs the captivating “Nica's Dream” in Holland in 1965, and delight in the expressive beauty of his rendition of “Here's That Rainy Day”, recorded in London in that same year.

programme.title: Duets: Carla Bley and Steve Swallow in 1988
programme.desc: If any two musicians share a special bond when they perform, it’s pianist Carla Bley and bassist Steve Swallow. The two have performed in the same bands since the 1960s and have been romantic partners for more than two decades. Watching them perform is the definition of musical telepathy. A glance or a smile?seems to change the feel of the music.

programme.desc: In 1968 traden het orkest van de Belgische pianist Francy Boland, de band van de Nederlandse trompettist Boy Edgar en de Amerikaanse band van trompettist Thad Jones en drummer Mel Lewis op tijdens het Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam.

programme.title: Salif Keita And Les Ambassadeurs
programme.desc: Salif Keita’s music is a rich combination of traditional Malian music with European and American influences. We can hear this in the instrumentation of Keita’s music, which varies from traditional West-African instruments to Western European ones. The Malian singer was cast out by his family because of his albinism. In 1967 he moved to Bamako, where he started his musical career and joined Les Ambassadeurs (Internationaux).

programme.title: Les McCann: Live in New Orleans
programme.desc: Self-taught musician Les McCann became the international jazz superstar he is today after the release of his album “Swiss Movement” which he recorded in 1968 with the late Eddie Harris. Yet there is much more to this musician than that one record.

programme.title: Earl Hines Quartet in Spa, 1977
programme.desc: Despite his advanced age, the legendary jazz pianist Earl Hines was at the top of his game when he performed in the Belgian town of Spa in 1977. With a band consisting of Rudy Rutherford (reeds), Jimmy Leary (bass), and Eddie Graham (drums), Hines livens up the room with his interpretations of “I Can’t Believe That You’re In Love With Me” and “The Man I Love.

programme.title: A$AP Rocky And A$AP Ferg - At The Hordern Pavilion
programme.desc: Big hits, booty dancing, stage dives, fan freestyles and of course, controversy, A$AP Rocky's debut Down Under tour had it all! At his sold-out Sydney show, hip hop's hottest star and 5000 rowdy fans got wild for the night at the Hordern Pavilion and we captured it all exclusively.

programme.title: Michelle David - Jazz in Duketown
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned artists. The talented American singer Michelle David performs pop and gospel music that feeds the heart and soothes the soul. Having grown up with the church, she started singing at the age of four. A year later she joined her first band, The Mission of Love.

programme.title: WCCB: Sara Bailey vs. Evelin Bermudez T2025 - Ep. 920
programme.desc: LIVE September 21st from the Hard Rock Casino in Ottawa, Canada, undefeated WBA Light Flyweight World Champion Sara Bailey of Ontario and IBF/WBO Light Flyweight World Champion Evelin Bermudez of Argentina meet to unify the titles. Bailey claimed her title in just her fourth professional fight defeating Guadalupe Bautista, and Bermudez became a two-time champion when beating Tania Enriquez before two successful defenses.

programme.title: WCK T2025 - Ep. 1115

programme.title: Greatest Classics T1 - Ep. 50

programme.title: KNOCKOUTS! T1 - Ep. 11

programme.title: FS Grand Sumo T27 - Ep. 4

programme.title: American Ninja Warrior T7 - Ep. 12

programme.desc: Two newlyweds find themselves inadvertently separated from their husbands moments after their respective weddings.
